scope: Contact-free robot-only measured-effort interface capture; not motor-work or cutting qualification
route: Existing near-approach plan02, waypoints240 through255 inclusive,8 linear physics substeps per waypoint interval; initial-state assignment at240, then withdrawal only
controller: Existing corrected controller: original implicit gains and effort limits, consistent desired velocities, bounded arm-only native gravity compensation
acceptance: Accessible finite fresh effort buffers; declared joint/body order; preserved commands and full incoming wrenches; projection consistency; inherited clear-space robot gates; exact counts and source closure
limitations: Projected effort is transmitted active-axis load, not automatically isolated motor torque; same-backend projection agreement does not prove physical accuracy or interval averaging. No complete-work pass criterion is asserted.
stop: One invocation; no physical rerun, parameter tuning, contact, target solve, fracture, video or training. Unsupported or inconsistent readback ends the protocol.
